title: collectGrepFlagChars only walks flag tokens that immediately follow the grep wo…
body: collectGrepFlagChars only walks flag tokens that immediately follow the grep word, so flags placed AFTER the pattern/file operand (e.g. `grep 'X' -q -L file`) are not scanned. This is out of scope per US-001's enumerated forms and the 'no full shell tokenizer' note, so it is non-blocking, but a future rule could widen coverage to operand-trailing flags.
